apps.name: JWLink
apps.author: jgm240
apps.description: Companion app for the JWatch (Bluetooth LE)
apps.long: Scan for and connect to your JWatch over Bluetooth Low Energy, sync the time, find the watch, set Do Not Disturb, rename it and read battery, steps and firmware. Uses jgmDeb's built-in Bluetooth LE stack.

system.notes: Calls: voice over 2G/3G (circuit-switched) by default because no carrier IMS profile is active; call end reason shown.
